The no-card shell run is decided server-side: the dsflash profile carries sandbox {enabled, mode auto, workspace_write, network deny} and upstream only asks when the command policy returns Ask (ApprovalPolicy::Ask default; WorkspaceWrite keeps the writable sandbox). The 'Ask for approval' pill is a static artboard label — the string does not exist in the web source (the web's live control is Read/Write/Full access from permission/profile/list).
